evidence.title: Order cancelled in the same block its backer closed
evidence.detail: The test trader closed its 3.57 HYPE long (tx index 2). The vault's reactivity callback, a validator-issued onEvent call, cancelled the bid that position backed at 76.98 in the same block (tx index 16).

evidence.title: A redemption cancels resting orders to free collateral
evidence.detail: Redeeming every share of the first vault cancelled its three resting orders and returned exactly 100 USDso.

evidence.title: The contract refuses an order outside a backer's catch window
evidence.detail: Keeper proposals whose backers moved before the send were rejected with OutsideBand(account, lo, hi, price); five in one pass on this vault, one on the first.

evidence.title: A resting order filled and the callback took the position
evidence.detail: ETH ask at 2,415.43 filled; the callback posted a buy-back bid at 2,324.28, beyond entry. The filler was an ordinary placeOrder, not a liquidation; the reactivity callback recorded the position and offered it back in the same block.

evidence.title: A resting order filled and the callback took the position
evidence.detail: SOL ask at 106.14 filled; the callback posted a buy-back bid at 100.39. The filler was an ordinary placeOrder, not a liquidation; the reactivity callback recorded the position and offered it back in the same block.

evidence.title: A resting order filled and the callback took the position
evidence.detail: HYPE bid at 76.80 (the test trader's window edge) filled by a taker; the callback posted a sell-back ask at 79.98. The filler was an ordinary placeOrder, not a liquidation; the reactivity callback recorded the position and offered it back in the same block.

evidence.title: A resting order filled and the callback took the position
evidence.detail: AVAX bid at 8.203 filled; the callback posted a sell-back ask at 8.712. The filler was an ordinary placeOrder, not a liquidation; the reactivity callback recorded the position and offered it back in the same block.

evidence.title: Six more orders cancelled by callbacks when backers moved
evidence.detail: Overnight on vault v2, validator-issued onEvent calls released six orders whose backers' windows no longer contained the price.

evidence.title: A liquidation filled into a vault order
evidence.detail: Two test accounts hold 20x HYPE positions, a long liquidating near 76.77 and a short near 81.60. The vault rests a bid and an ask at the edges of their catch windows, and a watcher calls the permissionless liquidate() the moment either account is under maintenance.
